newsitem.title: RUSSIA: SOCCER-DEFENDING CHAMPIONS SPARTAK TAKE LEAD.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-DEFENDING CHAMPIONS SPARTAK TAKE LEAD.

text.p: Defending champions Spartak Moscow secured the undisputed top spot in the Russian league after their 2-0 win at home over mid-table Zhemchuzhina Sochi on Wednesday.
Playmaker Andrei Tikhonov and second-half substitute Miroslav Romashchenko scored late in the game for the Muscovites, who now have 37 points after 18 matches, two points ahead of city rival Dynamo.
In the Moscow derby between CSKA and Dynamo, Andrei Kobelev opened the score with a free kick for Dynamo in the 76th minute but Dmitry Khomukha equalised just three minutes later for a 1-1 draw.

Rotor Volgograd, who were leading the league only a week ago, suffered a shock 2-1 loss to Chernomorets in Novorossiisk despite a goal by the league's top scorer Oleg Veretennikov -- his 11th of the season.
In two other surprise results, Zenit lost 1-0 at home in St Petersburg to last-placed Fakel Voronezh, while in Moscow fourth-placed Torpedo LM were defeated by Shinnik Yaroslavl 2-1.
